item.title: GlutaNex Glutathione Face Cream for Night, 30 g - with Niacinamide, Vitamin C and Hyaluronic Acid
item.description: GlutaNex Glutathione Night Cream, 30 g jar. A night cream with glutathione, niacinamide (vitamin B3), vitamin C, hyaluronic acid, retinol, ceramides, salicylic acid, peptides, aloe vera, turmeric and neem, made for brighter-looking, more even-looking skin. Use at night, start 2 to 3 nights a week, and use sunscreen every morning. Not for use during pregnancy or breastfeeding unless a doctor approves. Patch test before use. Cosmetic product; results vary. Free shipping across India, Cash on Delivery available.
